name: Synapse Data Center power plant, Olds, Alberta — SCR emissions control
description: Each 140 MW combined-cycle block has dual-path SCR (high-temperature zeolite and low-temperature vanadium catalyst grids), ammonia injection and a bypass-stack SCR path; SCR catalyst is treated as hazardous material in the decommissioning estimate.

capex.basis: Lazard LCOE+ v18.0 sensitivity; high case $60/ton; applied to generation-related emissions only, not embodied carbon

capex.metric: refurbished aero-derivative installed price including emissions control and medium-voltage switchgear
capex.basis: HTR: single Canadian utility filing for 2 x 50 MW; only public installed price for a refurbished aero-derivative package; includes emissions control

capex.metric: firm transportation reservation cost, Bridge pipeline serving Canady's CCGT
capex.basis: IEEFA estimate using 325,000 dekatherms/day at an indicative $0.50/dekatherm/day; 20-year total $1.18bn, NPV $614m, equal to 12.3% of the plant's estimated cost

capex.metric: gas pipeline construction cost increase for projects completed since 2024
capex.basis: BTU Analytics analysis of FERC and EIA data quoted by IEEFA; price per mile basis
